game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass, a narrow pumice pass: the fire warden must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the fire warden's power beats the shield shown by molten golems.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass: a narrow pumice pass
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Read a rectangle's width and height. Calculate its area and display the result. Test dataset 5: {'width': 6, 'height': 7}; {'width': 8, 'height': 2}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comparison Duel' (Week 2 slot 5), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Pumice Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Collect 130 points of sulfur crystals by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 130, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
